note: Shared allow/block/break-glass command corpus for BOTH Agent-Mail guards (bead claude-19xh, T7). run-corpus.mjs feeds every command through hooks/agent-mail-guard.js (the Claude hook, via CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT) AND the inlined tool.execute.before port in opencode/plugins/agent-flywheel.js (via output.args.command), and asserts BOTH produce the case's expected decision. Behavior is what matters, not regex source strings — a whitespace change in either guard cannot cause false drift here, but a real divergence in the block/allow decision fails the runner. Decisions: block = the guard refuses the command (source hook exit 2 / plugin handler throws); allow = the guard lets it through (source hook exit 0 / plugin handler returns).
